title: Unit – 1 : Session – 8 : SLO – 1  |  Binary arithmetic and BCD operations
sections: 1. Sign Magnitude representation — b) Separate bit for sign, remaining for magnitude
2. 1's Complement — e) Invert all bits of the subtrahend
3. 2's Complement — c) Invert all bits and add 1 to LSB
5. BCD Addition — a) Add 0110 (6) for correction if sum > 9

1. Sign Magnitude — Addition: same signs → add magnitudes, keep sign (+3=0011, +2=0010 → 0101=+5). Subtraction (+5)-(+3): compare magnitudes, subtract smaller from larger (101-011=010), keep sign of larger → 0010 = +2.
2. 1's Complement — Addition: add all bits incl. sign, add end-around carry. Subtraction 7-2: 0111 + 1's of 0010 (1101) = 1 0100 → EAC → 0100+1 = 0101 = +5.
3. 2's Complement — Subtraction 7-2: 0111 + 2's of 0010 (1110) = 1 0101 → discard carry → 0101 = +5. No carry → negative result, take 2's complement for magnitude.
4. Multiplication 1011 × 101 (11×5): partial products by shift-and-add → 0110111 (55). Division 1010 ÷ 10 (10÷2): repeated shift-and-subtract (long division) → quotient 0101 (5), remainder 0.
